faq_heading: Fraserview condos and townhomes: your questions answered

blocks.text: Draft for Jared's approval. Built only from the monthly MLS® figures (SnapStats) for condos and townhomes in Fraserview. No local notes, sold prices, building list or live listing feed yet; see the open items.

Fraserview, New Westminster: 57 condos and townhomes listed at the end of October 2026 and 7 sold in the month, a sales ratio of 12%, which the reports’ scale reads as a balanced market. By listings that is number 4 of 14 New Westminster communities for condos and townhomes.

blocks.source: Source: MLS® data from the Greater Vancouver REALTORS® and the Fraser Valley Real Estate Board, compiled by SnapStats®. Sales ratio is homes sold divided by homes listed. On the reports’ own scale under 12% is a buyers’ market, 12% to 20% is balanced and over 20% is a sellers’ market. With fewer than ten homes listed, one sale moves the ratio a long way, so treat it as a rough signal. The reports count condos and townhomes together in one line, so this table cannot separate the two. Shares are this community’s count divided by the New Westminster total for condos and townhomes that month.

blocks.text: Listings of condos and townhomes in Fraserview fell from 70 in June to 57 in October (−18.6%), and 44 sold across the 5 months. In October the community held 13.8% of New Westminster’s 413 condos and townhomes listed.

blocks.text: Fraserview home prices: what sold, November 2025 to October 2026

71 condos sold in Fraserview with a median price of $645,000 (the middle half sold between $581,000 and $697,500), taking a median of 21 days to sell at 97.1% of the last list price; 6% sold above list. They had a median $599 per square foot, a median year built of 2007 and a median strata fee of $580 a month. 22 townhomes sold in Fraserview with a median price of $1,077,000 (the middle half sold between $968,000 and $1,129,250), taking a median of 10 days to sell at 98.5% of the last list price; 14% sold above list. They had a median $460 per square foot, a median year built of 1994 and a median strata fee of $596 a month.

faq.q: How many condos and townhomes are for sale in Fraserview?
faq.a: At the end of October 2026 the Greater Vancouver REALTORS® figures showed 57 condos and townhomes listed in Fraserview. That is a month-end count and it moves daily; ask Jared what is on the market today.

faq.q: Is Fraserview a buyers’ or sellers’ market for condos and townhomes?
faq.a: In October 2026, condos and townhomes in Fraserview had a sales ratio of 12%, which the reports’ scale reads as a balanced market. On the reports’ scale under 12% favours buyers, 12% to 20% is balanced and over 20% favours sellers.

faq.q: How many condos and townhomes sold in Fraserview from June to October 2026?
faq.a: 44 condos and townhomes sold in Fraserview over those 5 months, out of 327 in all of New Westminster.

faq.q: Do these numbers separate condos from townhomes?
faq.a: No. The monthly reports publish condos and townhomes as one line, so every count here includes both. Jared can pull the split for a specific building or street.

faq.q: What did condos in Fraserview sell for?
faq.a: 71 condos sold in Fraserview between November 1, 2025 to October 22, 2026, with a median price of $645,000.

faq.q: How long do condos take to sell in Fraserview?
faq.a: The median was 21 days from listing to sale, and homes sold at a median 97.1% of the last list price (6% sold above list), for sales November 1, 2025 to October 22, 2026.
